title: 第13章 等级野兽第14章 经验爆落
slug: 看见血条的我选择打爆世界
content_zh:
风餐露宿的旅途非常辛苦，但周元却能从中获利。
在出行三天后，他的跑步能力终于技能化了，使他在奔走时也能产生收益。
【你领悟了‘健步’，掌握了一种生活技能。】
【健步，lv1（110）】
【效果：劲发于腰、力抵与足，行路蕴养耐力，跑动提升速度。】
技能健步的出现，最直观的影响是周元的移动速度变快了，更高的价值是拥有蕴养耐力的功能。
此时周元已经拥有，食补、休养、健步三个生活技能，力劈华山、枪刺两个攻击技能。
但他依然不满足，随行的路上收集了不少细小枯枝，折成手指长短练起了投掷。
“石头，别总拿树枝投我，你要闲着没事，就多收集点柴火，省的到了下一个驿站再寻找。”
“大黄叔，你忍忍，小树枝打到身上不痛不痒的，你就当我在跟你闹着玩儿。”
“桥西队正，你是不是在练眼力，想学射？
我可告诉你啊，学了弓箭就回不了乡了，能拉弓射箭的都是精兵，年老体衰之前，军营说什么也不会放行的。”
领队的差役们在野外时出奇的好说话，并没有随意打骂役丁的举动。
一般出了事儿，他们都是转告各村队正，让队正们下去解决。
周元看得出来，他们这是担心乡党闹事，有意将管理矛盾，丢给乡党内部自行消化。
因此，这些个差役平时和周元相处的十分融洽，熟悉后还经常聚在一起聊天。
“我年轻力壮，又做了壮丁领队，多半躲不开正卒编制。
倒不如学点本事，做个待遇好的善射之士。”
“原来如此，军中重勇崇射，你若能开硬弓、射准箭，必会得到上官提携。”
“不过哥几个劝你一句，想以善射悍勇做晋身之资的人多的是。

悍勇凭的是一腔热血，善射就要看天分了，仅靠苦练很难超越身边的袍泽。”
“多谢相告，我不强求、且试且行。”
武能壮胆气，胆壮气质明，差役们看着面前英姿勃发的少年郎，突然感觉这少年应该真回不来了。
有志族贱者，或没于沙场，或蹉跎年华、艰晋其身。
“快些走，黄昏降至，野外更深露重不易安眠，还是尽快抵达驿站为好。”
一行人说说笑笑苦中作乐，大部分交流家中田亩，少部分倾诉军中向往。
唯有差役们知道，没几分勇武血气，服兵役还不如服徭役。
毕竟那座军帐之中都是厮杀汉子，到底要用拳头说话，越弱越惨、越强越盛。
周元走在队伍一侧，看着熙熙攘攘的村汉们，知道这些人是他最有可能争取的班底。
辅兵者三年服役、正卒者十年效命，就算这些村汉全是辅兵、不入正卒，他们也要从军三年之久。
这些人是他的乡党，只要他成为这些人中最强的那个，他们就会自发围拢在他的身边，听他驱使、为他效命。
“砰、砰、砰···”
赶在夜幕降临前，周元一行人总算抵达了下一个驿站。
只不过这座驿站大门紧闭、灯火皆无，差役们只好上前敲门。
“咋这么晚才到，进去吧，吃食没有了，热水倒是有，你们凑活凑活得了。”
一位年老的驿卒打开大门，将差役们引入院中。
content_en:
The journey of sleeping in the open air was very hard, but Zhou Yuan was able to profit from it.
After three days of traveling, his running ability was finally skilled, allowing him to generate income while running.
[You have understood ‘healthy walking’ and mastered a life skill. 】
[Jianbu, lv1 (110)]
[Effect: Strength is generated in the waist, strength reaches the feet, building endurance while walking, and increasing speed when running. 】
The most intuitive impact of the emergence of the skill Jianbu is that Zhou Yuan's movement speed has become faster. The higher value is that it has the function of accumulating endurance.
At this time, Zhou Yuan already possesses the three life skills of Food Replenishment, Recuperation, and Healthy Walking, and the two attack skills of Splitting Huashan and Spear Stab.
But he was still not satisfied. He collected a lot of small dead branches on the way, folded them into finger lengths and practiced throwing.
"Stone, don't keep throwing branches at me. If you have nothing to do, just collect more firewood and save yourself searching for it at the next station."
"Uncle Big Huang, please bear with me. If you get hit by a small branch, it won't hurt or itch. Just think I'm joking with you."
“Captain Qiaoxi, are you practicing your eyesight and want to learn to shoot?
Let me tell you, if you learn bow and arrow, you will not be able to return to your hometown. Those who can draw a bow and shoot arrows are elite soldiers. Before they are old and frail, the military camp will not let you go no matter what. "
The leading officers were surprisingly easy to talk to in the field and did not beat or scold the officers at will.
Usually when something goes wrong, they will tell the team leaders of each village and ask the team leaders to go down and solve the problem.
Zhou Yuan could tell that they were worried about the township party causing trouble, and deliberately left the management conflicts to be resolved within the township party.
Therefore, these servants usually get along very well with Zhou Yuan, and they often get together to chat after becoming familiar with him.
"I'm young and strong, and I'm a strong man leading a team, so I probably can't escape the formation of regular soldiers.
It's better to learn some skills and become a good shooter who is well paid. "
"I see. Archery is highly valued in the army. If you can shoot a hard bow and shoot accurate arrows, you will definitely be promoted by your superiors."
"But I would like to advise you, there are many people who want to use their good shooting skills and bravery as a qualification for advancement.
Being brave depends on your passion, and being good at shooting depends on your talent. It is difficult to surpass the people around you just by practicing hard. "
"Thank you for telling me, I won't force it, I'll just give it a try."
Martial arts can embolden you with courage, and your courage and temperament are bright. When the officers looked at the heroic young man in front of them, they suddenly felt that this young man would never come back.
Those who have ambitions and a lowly family may end up dead in the battlefield, or may waste their years and struggle to advance to the next level.
"Go faster, dusk is falling, and the wilderness is deeper and heavier, making it difficult to sleep peacefully. It's better to arrive at the inn as soon as possible."
The group talked and laughed and had fun, most of them talked about their family fields, and a few talked about their longing for the army.
Only the officers knew that without any courage and courage, military service was worse than corvée service.
After all, there are men fighting in that military tent. In the end, the fists have to speak. The weaker, the more miserable, and the stronger, the more prosperous.
Zhou Yuan walked on one side of the team and looked at the bustling villagers, knowing that these people were the team he was most likely to win over.
Auxiliary soldiers serve for three years, and regular soldiers serve for ten years. Even if these villagers are all auxiliary soldiers and not regular soldiers, they still have to serve in the army for three years.
These people are his villagers. As long as he becomes the strongest among these people, they will spontaneously surround him, listen to his driving and serve him.
"Bang, bang, bang..."
Before nightfall, Zhou Yuan and his party finally arrived at the next station.
However, the door of the inn was closed and there were no lights, so the officers had no choice but to knock on the door.
"Why did you arrive so late? Come on in. There is no food, but there is hot water. You can make ends meet."
An old postman opened the door and led the guards into the courtyard.
